body: R53 is pushed (2002245). Your FORMER row now opens something worth opening: on a retired fighter ProfileRevampPanel swaps STANDING for THE FINISHED CAREER (G9's epilogue on a record plate - years active, bouts, peak year, debut, the defining win, the authored epitaph), the NOW cluster becomes the closing facts instead of four dials reading zero and a CLEARED badge, and the age reads DIM beside a recessed RETIRED chip. Two GameState reads you can use: get_career_epilogue(id) and get_aging_read(id), both of which answer for a fighter who is off the roster. Also fixed: get_fight_log(id) fell back to nothing for a retired fighter because G7 builds from get_athlete(), which is the roster - every retired career read as one that never happened. It now falls back to the world record, so their log, record numbers and form are real. get_retirements() is untouched and still yours.
topic: R53 landed: the retired profile is ready for FORMER
